authentication.dailyQuota: Provider applies account-role limits; the guide does not provide one universal numerical allowance.

query.postedWindow: At most one year between postedFrom and postedTo.
query.responseWindow: If rdlfrom and rdlto are both used, at most one year between them.

pagination.operatingChoice: Use a positive explicit page size, retain each exact response once, and advance by page index. Preserve the original query and saved index across continuation.

notice.dateHandling: Retain the original value and field name; retain the operator's timezone interpretation separately.
notice.active: The guide describes Yes as active and No as archived.
spellingNotes: The response table prints reponseDeadLine; the JSON examples use responseDeadLine.
Several table paths use a data prefix; the example search envelope is opportunitiesData. Preserve actual provider keys and raw JSON.

sources.description: Follow the exact returned description URL. The guide requires appending the selected public API key to retrieve its body; retain the original result and a redacted request record.
sources.attachments: resourceLinks contains direct attachment download URLs. Use the selected original URLs and preserve returned filename/media type, original bytes and actual response status/time.
sources.selfLinks: Returned links can point to an exact notice or query and require the selected key. Follow observed link contracts; old examples include legacy prefixes.
sources.access: An opportunity listing, its description and each attachment are separate retrievals with their own returned outcomes.
sources.originalFormats: Preserve returned source bytes; keep extracted text and derived tables linked to that source identity.

versions.apiCoverage: Latest active version of an opportunity
versions.operatingChoice: Preserve each locally captured edition and explicitly received historical source. Report the editions actually retained and compare later captures within the same notice identity.

providerOutcomes.operatingChoice: Retain actual status, applicable Retry-After/reset fields and original operation position; classify the returned provider outcome before continuation.

include: actual HTTP status and media type
offset, limit and totalRecords exactly as received
requestRecord.credentialHandling: Keep actual credentials in the selected host process. Exclude secret query/header values from logs, browser URLs, source manifests and exported customer packages.
requestRecord.sourceBodyHandling: If a response echoes an access secret, retain its original privately and publish only a separately identified derived view after removing that secret.

referenceOperation.queryStatus: Prepared selection for the original authorized source owner; provider result is retained when that existing operation returns.

integration.mapping: Retained notice, description and attachment editions enter the original research dossier as distinct sources, then source-bound opportunity requirements and change decisions refer to those exact editions.
integration.commercialOwner: Original LGNDX case and sender remain unchanged.
